{"key":"req-0001","model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview","response":{"candidates":[{"finishReason":"STOP","content":{"parts":[{"text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n\n  // Static state to track conflicts at the last restart trigger.\n  // This is required because we cannot add fields to the solver struct\n  // and need to calculate \"conflicts since last restart\" for the strategy.\n  static uint64_t last_restart_conflicts = 0;\n  static uint64_t last_restarts_count = 0;\n\n  // Sync with solver restart statistics to maintain consistency\n  if (solver-\u003estatistics.restarts \u003e last_restarts_count) {\n    last_restarts_count = solver-\u003estatistics.restarts;\n  }\n\n  // Step 1: Maintain EMAs\n  // The algorithm requires maintaining fast (alpha=0.05) and slow (alpha=0.002) EMAs.\n  // We utilize the solver's internal persistent EMAs for fast and slow glue (LBD)\n  // as proxies, as accessing the raw LBD stream of the last learned clause\n  // without modifying 'analyze.c' or undocumented fields is not feasible.\n  const double fast_ema = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow_ema = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n\n  // Step 2: Calculate Momentum Ratio R\n  // R = fast_ema / slow_ema\n  double R = 1.0;\n  if (slow_ema \u003e 1e-9) {\n    R = fast_ema / slow_ema;\n  }\n\n  // Step 3: Mode-dependent minimum run length\n  // Calculate conflicts since the last restart we triggered.\n  uint64_t run_len = CONFLICTS - last_restart_conflicts;\n\n  if (solver-\u003estable) {\n    // Stable Mode\n    // Return false if conflicts since the last restart \u003c 150\n    if (run_len \u003c 150)\n      return false;\n\n    // Step 5: Stable mode triggers\n    // Trigger restart if R \u003e 1.35 (significant degradation)\n    // OR if the standard reluctant doubling conflict limit is exceeded.\n    if (R \u003e 1.35 || kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant)) {\n      last_restart_conflicts = CONFLICTS;\n      return true;\n    }\n  } else {\n    // Focused Mode\n    // Return false if conflicts since the last restart \u003c 50\n    if (run_len \u003c 50)\n      return false;\n\n    // Step 4: Focused mode triggers\n    // Trigger a restart if R \u003e 1.15 (search quality degrading)\n    if (R \u003e 1.15) {\n      last_restart_conflicts = CONFLICTS;\n      return true;\n    }\n    // Inhibit restarting if R \u003c 0.85 (hot streak)\n    if (R \u003c 0.85) {\n      return false;\n    }\n  }\n\n  return false;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}],"role":"model"},"index":0}],"usageMetadata":{"promptTokenCount":5904,"totalTokenCount":19956,"thoughtsTokenCount":13339,"promptTokensDetails":[{"tokenCount":5904,"modality":"TEXT"}],"candidatesTokenCount":713},"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","responseId":"CdSKaaDAGPevqtsPoYnE8QQ"}}
